description: Reusable style vocabularies for prompt compilation and shot lists. Edit freely; no vendor or model is implied.

cinematic.look: cinematic live action, natural detail, restrained grading
cinematic.camera: locked-off medium shot with gentle push-in
cinematic.motion: subtle, physically plausible motion with stable geometry
cinematic.lighting: soft motivated key light with practical highlights
cinematic.palette: balanced neutral color with warm highlights

documentary.look: observational documentary, available light, unstaged framing
documentary.motion: natural camera drift, no artificial stabilization artifacts
documentary.lighting: available light with consistent white balance

social-short.look: punchy vertical short-form video with clear focal subject
social-short.camera: centered vertical medium shot with safe margins
social-short.motion: quick but readable motion with stable subject

music-video.look: stylized performance imagery synchronized to musical energy
music-video.motion: beat-aware motion with smooth transitions between sections
music-video.lighting: graphic colored lighting with controlled contrast
music-video.palette: bold accent palette with consistent grading

education.look: clear instructional imagery with legible diagrams
education.camera: stable frontal medium shot with generous caption space
education.motion: minimal motion that keeps labels readable
education.palette: high-contrast accessible color with limited accents

product.look: clean product hero imagery with accurate materials and labels
product.camera: three-quarter product hero shot on seamless background
product.motion: slow controlled rotation with accurate reflections
product.lighting: large softbox with crisp controlled specular highlights
